messages.subject: South Sudan ISO3 code
parts:
Although the version notes suggest the ISO3 code for South Sudan was changed to SSD in version 1.02-1, I'm using version 1.3-6 and the ISO3 code is SDS in at least a couple of the countries* (e.g., countriesLow, countriesCoarse, countryRegions) files. This package has been extremely useful, thank you.

Gopal Penny
